reviews.author: Richard Hill
reviews.text: Great bar with good food, nice friendly staff. Sunbeds for hire at the bar giving you full access to a fantastic beach. The ideal place for a day by the sea.

reviews.author: Lluís Bertran
reviews.text: Looking for a glass of wine, a cocktail or an aperitif on the beach? Here you have one of the best near to Barcelona in Vilanova i la Geltrú. The atmosphere is magnificent, the environment is great, the weather is almost sure good in summer season.

reviews.author: Isabella Dicaprio
reviews.text: Great place for a quick bite, a drink and a swim.

reviews.author: Francine Howard
reviews.text: Super friendly and welcoming, good food and nice drinks, lovely place on the beach.
